name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) is hard because the door opening is commanded and is a lone step. Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) is hard because the order 'then' stays hard even though the 'if possible' cue covers the box step. Existence(target_picked_up) is soft because the box pickup is worded as a preference. No clause is redundant and none is added.

texts: Open the door (the door must be open at some point).
Pick up the target box only after the door has been opened (the order is required).
If possible, pick up the target box in the other room.
